mapper.sql: uid, username, phone_number, email, nickname, avatar, description, gender, group_ids, roles, active, create_time, token_version, last_password_change_at, account_locked
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_info ( uid, username, phone_number, email, nickname, avatar, description, gender, group_ids, roles, password, active, create_time, token_version, last_password_change_at, account_locked ) VALUES ( #{uid}, #{username}, #{phoneNumber}, #{email}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{description}, #{gender}, #{groupIds}, #{roles}, #{password}, #{active}, #{createTime}, #{tokenVersion}, #{lastPasswordChangeAt}, #{accountLocked} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_info ORDER BY create_time DESC, uid DESC

SELECT FROM user_info
AND username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickname}, '%')
AND FIND_IN_SET(#{groupId}, group_ids)
AND gender = #{gender}
AND active = #{active}
ORDER BY create_time DESC, uid DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_info SET last_password_change_at = NOW(), token_version = COALESCE(token_version, 0) + 1 WHERE uid = #{uid}
UPDATE user_info SET account_locked = #{locked}, token_version = COALESCE(token_version, 0) + 1 WHERE uid = #{uid}
